Trailer For The Mandalorian And Grogu in 4K ULTRA HD Quality

The Mandalorian And Grogu Plot : Once a lone bounty hunter, Mandalorian Din Djarin and his apprentice Grogu embark on an exciting new Star Wars adventure.

The Mandalorian and Grogu, also known as Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, is an upcoming American film directed by Jon Favreau and co-written by Favreau, Dave Filoni, and Noah Kloor. Produced by Lucasfilm and set to be distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is part of the Star Wars franchise and a continuation of the Disney+ television series The Mandalorian (2019–2023). Pedro Pascal stars as Din Djarin / The Mandalorian alongside Sigourney Weaver and Jeremy Allen White. In the film, Djarin and his apprentice Grogu are enlisted by the New Republic following the fall of the Galactic Empire, during a period where remaining Imperial warlords threaten the galaxy.

The Mandalorian and Grogu is scheduled to be released in the United States on May 22, 2026.
